name: 黃昇
objective: Lumped Circuits & KCL, KVL, Circuit Elements, Series-Parallel Circuits, The RL & RC Circuits, The RLC Circuits,Linear Time-invarient Circuit Analysis, The Phasor & SSS Analysis, Magnetically Coupled Circuits, Polyphase Circuits.
課程進度(1-16週):
Week 1: Introductions and Circuit Variables.
Week 2: Circuit Elements.
Week 3: Simple Resistive Circuits
Week 4: Techniques of Circuit Analysis
Week 5: Techniques of Circuit Analysis
Week 6: The Operational Amplifier
Week 7: The Operational Amplifier
Week 8: Midterm
Week 9: Inductance, Capacitance, and Mutual Inductance
Week 10: Inductance, Capacitance, and Mutual Inductance
Week 11: Response of First-Order RL and RC Circuits
Week 12: Response of First-Order RL and RC Circuits
Week 13: Natural and Step Responses of RLC Circuits
Week 14: Natural and Step Responses of RLC Circuits
Week 15: Natural and Step Responses of RLC Circuits
Week 16: Final
Week 17-18: Self-directed Project
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 參與課程相關作業、作品、實驗、田野調查 (Participation in course-related assignments, works, experiments, or field research)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          第 17 至 18 週由學生依個人學習需求，自主複習電路學相關內容，並透過教材研讀與題目練習強化電路分析能力。
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          能理解電路分析之基本概念與方法，並運用所學完成相關電路問題之分析與計算。
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          自主學習成果依完成情形進行質性檢核。
